articles.title: YouTube introduces AI features to take on Spotify
articles.description: YouTube is late to this party, since Spotify introduced its AI DJ feature nearly two years ago. According to the company, the feature has seen engagement nearly double over the past year. Spotify's DJ is a virtual music assistant that creates personalised music mixes for users based on their listening history and global trends, offering commentary from an AI-generated voice.
